description: Unprobed. In a guard, div(x, 0) and rem(x, 0) make the clause fail in Elixir. The interpreter's guard evaluation may panic on a zero divisor instead. Probe on interp, run and build against elixir with `def f(x) when div(x, 0) > 0, do: :a; def f(_), do: :b`. Expected: :b on every path.
title: The interpreter's guard div and rem refuse a zero divisor without panicking
